% Core-language bootstrap fixture; no plain.tex or format file required.
\def\swap#1,#2;{#2/#1}
Delimited: \swap Alpha,Beta;\par
\long\def\paragraphs#1{#1}
\paragraphs{Long: First\par Long: Second}\par
\def\next{OK}
\def\check{\ifx\peek\next Futurelet: \else BAD\fi}
\futurelet\peek\check\next\par
\def\suffix{A}
\expandafter\edef\csname result\suffix\endcsname{Dynamic: \swap Left,Right;}
\csname resultA\endcsname\par
\count0=0
\def\iterate{\ifnum\count0<500 \advance\count0 by 1 \expandafter\iterate\fi}
\iterate
Finite: \the\count0\bye
